title: rosa alpina var. hispida
intro: Rosa alpina var. hispida, commonly known as alpine rose or Rosa hispida, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the Himalayan region and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa alpina var. hispida include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
